reader_summary.headline: The beginning of a new year brings with it time for reflection and the renewal of rituals.
reader_summary.overview: The beginning of a new year brings with it time for reflection and the renewal of rituals. We reflect on our personal and professional lives, set goals for the coming year. One part of the ritualistic sprint is conference season.

key_points.text: We reflect on our personal and professional lives, set goals for the coming year.
Industry leaders gather at Davos for the World Economic Forum and Miami for iConnections Global Alts in January.
We'll be doing the same at our Capital Allocators CIO Summit in April, Senior Decision Makers Summit in June, Capital Allocators University in July.
